name: Kent Automatic Iron Removal Filter-100L
summary: The KENT Automatic Iron Removal Filter – 100L is a high-capacity whole-house iron removal system designed to eliminate excess iron from raw water.
intro: The KENT Automatic Iron Removal Filter – 100L is a high-capacity whole-house filtration system designed to remove excess iron from raw water. With a 100-litre media capacity and a flow rate of up to 4000 LPH, it ensures a continuous supply of clean, iron-free water for homes, villas, apartments, and commercial establishments. The system helps prevent rust stains, protects plumbing and appliances from scaling, and improves overall water quality. Featuring a fully automatic operation, LCD control panel, and compact floor-standing design, it offers reliable performance with minimal maintenance.
features: High Capacity Performance – 100L filtration media with a high flow rate of 4000 LPH.
Efficient Iron Removal – Effectively removes excess iron from raw water for cleaner and safer usage.
Protects Appliances – Prevents scaling and extends the lifespan of kitchen and bathroom appliances.
Compact Design – Space-saving floor-standing design for easy installation.
LCD Control Panel – User-friendly display for simple operation and system monitoring.
Fully Automatic Operation – Hassle-free functioning with automatic regeneration and minimal manual intervention.
High Capacity Performance – 100L filtration media with a high flow rate of 4000 LPH .
